items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I had Snooky Young, Jimmy Maxwell, a wonderful trumpet player... I brought in a lot of good players.

ctx.x: Did you give them the song titles?

Oh well I found a gimmick that worked for me. Since Cavett did not have a musical ear, does not have a musical ear, he used to say, I used to kind of begrudge it but I really, it was a compliment. He said, “I don’t know anything too much about music, but everybody tells me this band is wonderful.” Which is a typical Cavett remark, you know? And we’d all go ahhhh. But it’s the best band in town. And I picked anybody I wanted. The job paid a lot of money, it was staff orchestra at ABC. That’s when the three…
